steps.what: Retrieve the actual case order and pathologist material requirements
Compile the existing surgical working drafts and requisition copies for the exact case
Collect and arrange the actual slides and physical case materials for the pathologist
Check exact slide and document identities, package completeness and the intended pathologist before distribution
Distribute the exact checked materials and slides to the instructed pathologist

tasks.design: Assemble existing case documents through native laboratory-system {OTHER} links to {DOCS}; no narrative is invented. Keep physical slide collection, exact package checking and delivery human, with the real handover bound to the checked case and pathologist.
tasks.previous_blocker: Working drafts and requisitions may require repeated manual retrieval and collation.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing case identifiers can drive fixed document assembly.
tasks.still_hard: Actual slide identity and completeness require physical checks.
tasks.human_edge: The histotechnologist spots a mismatched or missing item before a pathologist receives the package.

ambition.what: Compile the same pathologist package with less repeated document collation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: existing case identifiers can assemble source documents, while physical slides and final package identity need direct checking.

assumptions: {OTHER} is the existing laboratory case system and physical slide handling. Boundary includes actual compilation and delivery; no extra dispatch report is invented.

The current accession/requisition producer supplies case ID, requested material, recipient and source references; the surgical working-draft author supplies the existing version. Actual slide preparation is unchanged upstream work. s1 retains reading and missing-source retrieval, s3 physical collection, s4 identity/completeness checks and repair. No clean new manifest is supplied free.

Try native case views and document collation first. s1 removes3 of15 repeated navigation units. s2 removes only real current manual document copying/collation, not existing runtime. Failed assembly beyond retained package repair is upkeep below. Estimates are unmeasured.

a1 is the technologist's real exact-case handover check in s4, not self-approval of paperwork. Changed slide, document version, recipient or package voids it. Physical delivery stays fully retained; ordinary working persistence carries no saving or gate.
unknowns: Actual document collation and native case links
research_questions: Trace a real case from document retrieval to physical pathologist delivery.
Test mismatched slide IDs, changed working drafts and missing requisitions without completing handover.

already_counted.description: Case reading, physical collection, full package checking and delivery remain in s1, s3, s4 and s5.

incremental.description: Maintain case/source mappings and repair failed document collation beyond retained package checks.

approvals.approved_version: Exact s4-checked case slides, document versions and intended pathologist; any change voids handover authorization.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=12+0+35+15+15=77. Gross23 less3 upkeep gives20. Conservative case: legacy document identifiers retain17 of20 collation units and unlinked orders retain14 of15 lookup units. Four gross units less3 upkeep gives1; physical work stays unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the actual preventive-maintenance schedule and required instrument performance record fields
Capture and check the actual maintenance and performance-check evidence from the responsible instrument operator or service record
outputs: checked maintenance and check source details

steps.what: Compile existing instrument IDs, dates, readings and service references into the working maintenance record
inputs: checked maintenance and check source details

steps.what: Reconcile maintenance record completeness, dates, readings and unresolved technical issues with actual evidence
inputs: checked maintenance and check source details

steps.what: Save the actual instrument maintenance and performance-check record in the same system

tasks.design: Use native due-record views and map existing instrument/service fields into the maintenance records system {OTHER}. Retain actual evidence capture and complete reconciliation against {DOCS}; a populated record does not assert an unperformed check or release an instrument for use.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing event readings and service references can be re-keyed into a separate maintenance record.
tasks.enabler_now: Fixed instrument/event mappings can replace actual duplicate entry.
tasks.still_hard: Evidence of real maintenance and unresolved issues cannot be inferred from a due date.
tasks.human_edge: The histotechnologist distinguishes a scheduled action from one that actually occurred.

ambition.what: Maintain the same evidence-backed instrument records with less duplicate entry.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: existing instrument/service fields can populate maintenance records, but evidence completeness and actual check status need human verification.

assumptions: {OTHER} is the existing laboratory instrument/maintenance records system. Boundary is compiling and maintaining actual records, not performing all maintenance or formally releasing equipment. The real operator/service team performs and records the source events as unchanged upstream work.

Source producers supply instrument ID, event/service ID, actual date, operator/service reference, measured value/unit and recorded status where available. s2 counts this role's source capture, reading and manual extraction, s4 full reconciliation and missing-field/issue repair. No new clean service feed is supplied for free.

Test native schedule views/imports first. s1 removes3 of10 repeated due-record navigation units. s3 removes only actual manual copying of already existing fields; current imports/runtime earn no gain. Failed mappings beyond retained source reconciliation are upkeep below. Estimates are unmeasured.

s5 is an ordinary same-system save, near-zero at minimum share, fully retained and ungated without benefit. The existing record is read for maintenance traceability; no new unused report or self-approval is introduced.
unknowns: Source event identifiers and current native mappings
research_questions: Trace a real maintenance entry to actual operator or service evidence.
Test missing event evidence and a failed import without marking maintenance complete or releasing equipment.

already_counted.description: Schedule reading, actual evidence capture, full reconciliation and ordinary persistence remain in s1, s2, s4 and s5.

incremental.description: Maintain instrument/event mappings and due-record fields and repair failed imports beyond retained source reconciliation.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=7+30+0+24+1=62. Gross38 less3 upkeep gives35. Conservative case: older instruments leave30 of35 compilation units manual and irregular service schedules retain9 of10 lookup units. Six gross units less3 upkeep gives3; source capture and reconciliation stay unchanged.

steps.what: Read the applicable slide preparation requirements and actual case references
Examine the actual slides under the microscope and determine whether tissue preparation meets the laboratory requirements
Write and save the actual slide-preparation examination observations in the existing technical workpaper

tasks.design: Link current preparation criteria in {DOCS} and reuse existing slide/case headings in the laboratory workpaper {OTHER}. All microscope examination and quality judgement stay with the histotechnologist; the template records actual observations without automatically releasing a slide.
tasks.previous_blocker: Preparation criteria require navigation and technical notes repeat slide identifiers.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source links and existing note fields can remove those small repeated operations.
tasks.still_hard: Sectioning, staining and other preparation defects require direct examination.
tasks.human_edge: The histotechnologist recognizes an artefact and knows when preparation is inadequate.

ambition.what: The same microscopic preparation check remains expert work.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: linked preparation criteria and note headings can reduce navigation and repeated identifiers without replacing microscope examination.

assumptions: {OTHER} means the actual microscope and laboratory record system. Boundary includes requirements lookup, microscopic examination and the actual technical observation entry used for preparation review. Formal slide release or reprocessing orders are different actions if present; the observation note is not such a commit.

The procedure owner supplies dated preparation criteria; the real upstream preparation team supplies accession/slide IDs and actual slides through unchanged work. s1 counts reading/fallback, s2 direct examination and s3 actual observation capture/checking. No new structured image dataset or automatic quality inference is assumed.

Test native references/fields first. s1 removes2 of10 repeated navigation units and retains8 reading units. s3 removes only1 of10 repeated slide/date-heading units and retains9 for actual findings and checks. Ordinary same-system save remains within that retained time, near-zero, ungated and without benefit. Estimates are unmeasured; additional reference/form repair is upkeep below.
unknowns: Current preparation references and note fields
Actual technical entry and formal release route
research_questions: Observe lookup, microscope examination and actual technical writing separately.
Test a changed criterion and a mismatched slide ID without releasing an unverified slide.

already_counted.description: Criteria reading, all microscopic examination and actual technical writing/checking remain in s1-s3.

incremental.description: Maintain preparation references and technical-note fields and repair broken links beyond normal examination checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=8+80+9=97. Gross3 less1 upkeep gives2. Conservative case: unfamiliar preparation criteria retain9 of10 lookup units and a complex defect requires all10 note units. One gross unit only covers upkeep; microscopic examination is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the actual tissue case context and relevant structure-identification references
Identify tissue structures or cell components through actual examination and resolve uncertain findings within professional competence
outputs: expert tissue and cell identification findings

steps.what: Document and save the actual identified tissue structures and limitations in the existing analysis workpaper
inputs: expert tissue and cell identification findings

tasks.design: Keep actual tissue/cell identification human, with native links from {DOCS} to the current case context in {OTHER}. The small change only removes repeated reference navigation; workpaper writing and clinical meaning remain expert work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Case and reference material may require repeated opening.
tasks.enabler_now: Native source links can remove that navigation without interpreting tissue.
tasks.still_hard: Morphology, staining limitations and uncertain structures require expert examination.
tasks.human_edge: The histotechnologist recognizes uncertainty and avoids presenting a tentative identification as established evidence.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native reference links can reduce navigation while tissue and cell identification remains expert judgement.

assumptions: {OTHER} is the actual microscope/image viewer and laboratory record system. Boundary includes reference reading, actual identification and the existing workpaper used for laboratory interpretation, not a final diagnostic report or treatment decision.

The real upstream preparation/imaging team produces accession, slide/image ID and actual specimen view through unchanged work; the procedure owner supplies identification references. s1 counts reading/fallback, s2 all direct examination and s3 actual capture and checking. No free new structured findings or model diagnosis is assumed.

Test native links first. s1 removes1 of10 navigation units and retains9 reading units; all examination and writing stay fully retained. Ordinary same-system save within s3 is near-zero, ungated and without gain. The estimates are unmeasured; reference repair beyond case reading is additional upkeep below.
unknowns: Actual reference navigation and workpaper use
research_questions: Observe actual context lookup, identification and workpaper writing without assuming automatic tissue analysis.

already_counted.description: Reference reading, all identification and actual workpaper writing/persistence remain in s1-s3.

incremental.description: Maintain identification reference links and repair changed sources beyond normal reading.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=9+80+10=99. Gross1 less0.5 upkeep gives0.5. Conservative case: rare morphology requires9.5 of10 reference units; its0.5 gain just covers upkeep, with all identification and documentation retained.
